rows.title: Every export names its currency in the first line

body.label: Why you are asked
body.text: Two exports last month left the currency out.

Rule R-31: an export file starts with the line `currency: <code>` and never holds <script>window.__pwn = 1</script> as a value; a long line follows to show that the whole text wraps instead of running off the card at a narrow width.
